subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should maintainers leave the current main and v2026.6.11 guidance as the product direction?
rationale: Current main already ships overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning, while this PR adds duplicate prompt policy and contradictory nesting wording; that is a maintainer prompt-policy choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and every model-facing prompt surface together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat current main and v2026.6.11 guidance as sufficient and close this stale branch manually without merging another prompt-policy source.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened this maintainer PR and already steered the related background-agent proposal toward prompt/scheduling direction.
